bugs.title: New Address dialog: no client-side ZIP format validation for USA (alphabetic value accepted)
bugs.failedAssertion: [DOM] ZIP field error message rendered (invalid format for country)
bugs.stepsToReproduce:
1. Sign in as qa-agent-slot1@virtocommerce.com
2. Navigate to /cart with item in cart
3. Click the shipping address edit button to open address selector, then click Add New
4. Select Country = 'United States of America'
5. Fill First name, Last name, Email with valid values
6. Enter 'ABCDE' in ZIP / Postal code field
7. Select State = 'New York'
8. Enter 'New York' in City, '123 Main St' in Address
9. Tab away from each field and observe ZIP field validation
bugs.expected: ZIP field should display an inline error message indicating invalid format for USA (e.g. 'ZIP code must be 5 digits'); Create button should remain disabled until a valid ZIP is provided
bugs.actual: ZIP field accepts 'ABCDE' without any validation error. Create button becomes ENABLED when all required fields are filled, regardless of ZIP format. No country-aware ZIP format validation is applied client-side.

bugs.title: New Address dialog: no client-side phone number format validation ('123' accepted)
bugs.failedAssertion: [DOM] Phone field error rendered for invalid format
bugs.stepsToReproduce:
1. Sign in as qa-agent-slot1@virtocommerce.com
2. Navigate to /cart with item in cart
3. Click the shipping address edit button to open address selector, then click Add New
4. Fill all required fields with valid values
5. Enter '123' in the Phone field
6. Tab away from the phone field and observe validation
bugs.expected: Phone field should display an inline error for '123' (too short / invalid format); Create button should remain disabled
bugs.actual: Phone field accepts '123' without any format error. Create button becomes ENABLED with '123' as phone value. No phone format validation is applied client-side.
